metadata.description: The desktop Terminal's real rows (W5: A09, A11, A14, A24): the services host's terminal concern frame and root allowlist over a transferred port into the real shell service, sandbox provider and the machine's own Bash in a PTY. macOS PTY rows are recorded unverified until the operator's own-pty run. Writes a JSON receipt when TAU_SHELL_CONFORMANCE_RECEIPT is set. Never cached: a receipt is only evidence of the run that wrote it.
